component.name: Slayer Editor
component.summary: Lightweight code editor with an embedded terminal

description.p: Slayer Editor is a fast code editor with syntax highlighting, tabs and an embedded terminal that can be docked on any edge of the window. Press F5 to compile and run C, C++, Python, Rust, Go, JavaScript, Java and shell scripts.

screenshot.caption: Code and run in one place, with a built-in terminal
Run a script and stay in the interpreter
Open a folder as a project, then build and run it
A visual debugger: breakpoints, variables and call stack
Live HTML preview that reloads as you type
Quick Open and Find in Project
Configurable editor, terminal, languages and themes
Light and dark themes that can follow the system

description.p: The find bar now keeps a search history and uses Kate-style arrows, Go to Line opens as an inline bar instead of a dialog, and each file's cursor position is remembered between sessions. Wrapped-line indentation became an optional setting. Also fixes a crash when searching in a word-wrapped document.

Adds syntax highlighting for HTML, CSS, JSON, XML, Markdown and more, and a live HTML preview with automatic reload (built-in server or an external one such as PHP). New editor features: a code minimap, VS Code-style indentation guides, indentation of wrapped lines, auto-close of HTML/XML tags, an Open Recent menu and optional auto-save. Also fixes an editor freeze while editing HTML.

Fixes a crash when opening an empty file. Code completion now appears inline as ghost text (accepted with Tab) instead of a popup, matching block delimiters are highlighted, the disk-change bar can enable auto-reload, and files can be dropped onto the welcome screen.
Dragging a file onto the editor now opens it in a new tab instead of inserting its path as text.
